Name: Enchanted Galaxy and Infinity Weapons
Author: namelessto
Description:
[size=3][b]What does this mod do?[/b]
After you obtain a Galaxy Sword or an Infinity weapon, special barrels start appearing in the Mines and Skull Cavern. Break them for a chance to find a Galaxy or Infinity weapon — possibly with enchantments.

[b]How does it work?[/b]
Each day, when you enter a mine floor, there is a chance for one of these barrels to spawn. A small message will appear in the corner to let you know there is one waiting on that floor.

By default, up to 5 weapons can drop per day. The drop chance starts at 60% and increases by 5% every 20 floors, reaching 90% at floor 120. Dangerous mine variants give an additional 10% on top of that. Dropped weapons have a 50% chance for an innate enchantment and a 15% chance for a regular enchantment.

[b]Configuration[/b]
Almost everything is configurable via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Daily weapon drop limit
[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Base drop chance and per-floor scaling
[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Which mine sections can spawn barrels (Lower Mines, Mid Mines, Upper Mines, Dangerous Mines, Skull Cavern)
[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Which weapons can drop and weapon type weights (bias toward swords, daggers, or hammers)
[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Which enchantments and innate stats can appear
[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Support for weapon mods - any installed mod that adds weapons is automatically detected and can be toggled on or off
[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]
If you have feedback or encounter a bug, please let me know![/size]
